facts.fact: Open sarathi.parivahan.gov.in and select the State
facts.quote: How do I update/modify my mobile number on Driving License? Steps follow for Mobile number update in License :- 1. Visit https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/ 2. Select concerned state

facts.fact: Then choose 'Mobile Number Update' from the 'Others' menu
facts.quote: Steps follow for Mobile number update in License :- 1. Visit https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/ 2. Select concerned state 3. Click on "Mobile Number Update" from "Others" menu

summary: Sarathi > State > Others > Mobile Number Update confirmed on the Parivahan FAQ; expected answer unchanged.
